mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand in the economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is declining.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month AND FEDFUNDS > 2%
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% and FEDFUNDS is above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% in one month and Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for the previous quarter, it signals a weakening supply side and overall economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month AND GDPC1 < 0% in previous quarter
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% and GDPC1 growth is negative.
